result.document_summary: A mis-retrieved portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Government), covering Small and Local Business Program bid preferences, the Managed Competition Independent Review Board, and the start of Division 38 on construction manager at risk contracts, not the algorithmic rent-pricing section named in the source URL.
result.notes: This part contains only municipal procurement and administrative provisions (SLBE/ELBE bid discounts and preferences, bonding and insurance, Managed Competition Independent Review Board, construction manager at risk contracts). None of it concerns residential rent increases, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so no in-scope rules were extracted. The URL suggests San Diego Municipal Code section 98.1103 (use and sale of algorithmic devices prohibited), but that text is not in this part of the document.
